model.architecture_note: mT5-large Chinese route; not a pure parameter-count scaling of T5-77M; tokenizer/architecture audited before any run
model.source_note: Model card describes an mT5-large Chinese initialization; the released config is T5ForConditionalGeneration and the tokenizer is byte-identical to the 77M model. It is a larger pretrained base with changed pretraining/scale, not a pure parameter-count ablation.

device_precheck.required: 24GB-class GPU for full fp32 AdamW fine-tuning of 784M

fixed_material.withdrawn_review: v07: owner of 封面 uniquely recoverable from visible list; not B-only; plan refs/expression issue

sampling_replay.rule: reuse the 480 logged calls in exact order; same sourceId, callId, factIds, target, and optimizer configuration; tokenizer-induced token counts may differ and are recorded separately

comparisons.vs_B_large_77: per-example gains and regressions in omission, attribution, repetition, addition, expression; gains and regressions separately, no net-score offset
comparisons.vs_A_large_77: original B-only safety gate on 19 multi-fact groups; fixed and regression reported separately; t24/v20 remain; v07 is not safety
comparisons.promotion_if_pass: offline joint-sentence candidate only; no organization training and no service replacement

checkpoint_and_generation_identity.required: save final weights, config, tokenizer files and hashes; save actual generated tokens, stop reason EOS/cap/timeout for every call
checkpoint_and_generation_identity.length_precheck: tokenize all prompts/targets; if max 512/128 is exceeded, stop; no silent truncation or temporary relaxation
checkpoint_and_generation_identity.not_run: prechecks passed; training will save final weights and per-call records

cost.estimate: 1-2 GPU-hours on a 24GB GPU for one arm plus evaluation; 2 person-days
cost.note: same 120 updates is not the same compute as 77M; report measured wall time, peak memory, per-step time and token counts

stop_conditions: any B-only safety loss on the 19 multi-fact groups
any failure stops the larger-base route; no added steps, ratios, second base, or organization module

token_audit.meaning: same prompt/target text; tokenization is identical because the tokenizer file hash matches; no target/interface change
